# 99 Media & Tech (i99.sa) — مؤسسة تسعة وتسعون للإعلام والتقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي

> Saudi broadcast & cinema production house, AI engineering studio, and strategic communications establishment founded in 2014 and headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية).

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** 99 Commercial Establishment (مؤسسة تسعة وتسعون التجارية)
- **Founded:** 2014
- **Headquarters:** Jeddah, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia (21.5433° N, 39.1728° E)
- **Service Coverage:** Saudi Arabia (Jeddah, Riyadh, Eastern Province, Makkah, Madinah) and the wider GCC / MENA region

## 99 Media House (99 للإعلام — https://www.i99.sa/media/)

Founded in Jeddah in 2014, **99 Media** is a flagship Saudi television, cinema, generative AI video, and strategic communications production house combining veteran Arab broadcast direction with modern AI capabilities.

### Five Core Media Disciplines («عنوان 99»)
1. **Broadcast & Content Production («مدينة المحتوى»):** Television programs, documentaries, editorial scripts, and digital series crafted for Saudi and GCC audiences at 4K broadcast standards.
2. **Cinema & Audio Production («مبنى 99 للإنتاج»):** High-craft brand films, commercials, cinema optics cinematography, DaVinci color grading, and studio sound mastering.
3. **AI Cinema & Generative Video («مختبر سينما AI»):** Director-led generative AI brand films, virtual visual worlds, AI commercials, and hybrid VFX workflows delivering bold visuals at accelerated turnaround.
4. **Corporate Communications & Strategic PR («شارع الإبداع»):** Long-term PR architecture, flagship forum and summit coverage, executive positioning, and crisis communications governance.
5. **Digital Marketing & Reach («حي الإلهام»):** Research-led campaign strategy, social systems, paid media, and omnichannel reach integrated with 99 Tech & EXOX for live measurable impact.

### Official Partners & Selected Institutional Credits («صافحنا مهنياً»)
- **MBC Group** (مجموعة MBC)
- **Saudi Broadcasting Authority — SBA** (هيئة الإذاعة والتلفزيون)
- **Misk Foundation** (مؤسسة مسك الخيرية)
- **Al-Faisalya Welfare Society** (الجمعية الفيصلية الخيرية)
- **Taiba Women's Society** (جمعية طيبة النسائية)
- **Al-Dawaa** (صيدليات الدواء)
- **Zahra Association** (جمعية زهرة)
- **Ftah Al-Ahsa** (جمعية فتاة الأحساء)

### 35mm Production Workflow
1. Research & Creative Treatment (`SCRIPT`)
2. Art Direction & Pre-Production (`ART DIRECTION`)
3. Principal Shoot or AI Cinema Lab (`SHOOT & AI LAB`)
4. Color Grading, Broadcast & Distribution (`GRADE & BROADCAST`)

---

## 99 Tech & AI (99 للتقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي — https://www.i99.sa/tech/)

### Flagship Systems Engineered In-House
1. **EXOX (https://exox.ai)** — Autonomous AI Business Operating System. Starts from a single website link to preserve institutional brand memory and orchestrate SEO/GEO web presence, visual creatives, monthly publishing calendars, and multi-channel advertising campaigns under strict owner approval and instant-pause governance.
2. **PR MEDIA** — AI-Powered Media Intelligence & Strategic Communications platform analyzing live coverage and reputation signals to support executive communication decisions.
3. **FIRX** — AI Governance, Verification & Trusted Execution layer enforcing output compliance, decision audit trails, and enterprise AI safety.

### Five Core Engineering Disciplines
1. **AI Systems & Autonomous Agents:** Multi-agent orchestration, Arabic-native RAG architectures, LLM guardrails, structured enterprise memory, and owner-approved tool execution.
2. **Enterprise Software & SaaS Engineering:** Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, REST/GraphQL APIs, RBAC security, and ERP/CRM/payments integrations.
3. **Interactive Web Platforms & Mobile Apps:** 60fps bilingual Arabic (RTL) & English (LTR) web experiences engineered for SEO and GEO discoverability, plus native iOS & Android apps.
4. **Data Engineering & Business Intelligence:** Enterprise data pipelines, clean metric layers, executive KPI dashboards, and predictive analytics.
5. **Cloud Architecture & Zero-Trust Security:** Edge infrastructure (Cloudflare/AWS/Kubernetes), Zero-Trust WAF, zero-downtime CI/CD delivery, and 24/7 operational observability.

### Engineering Delivery Methodology
1. Discovery & Architecture (`BLUEPRINT`)
2. Design System & Prototyping (`CRAFT & UX`)
3. Iterative Engineering & Automated QA (`BUILD & QA`)
4. Zero-Downtime Launch & 24/7 Ops (`SCALE 24/7`)
